b5_forgedToken.deviationFromExpectation: The task expected 'no cookie' for a forged token. The shipped design deliberately sets one anyway: apps/web/app/s/[token]/route.ts never verifies the signature here, and sizes the cookie from the UNVERIFIED payload exp, because a maxAge that depended on signature validity would turn the cookie's own lifetime into a signature oracle. Authorization still fails closed one hop later at loadSharePreview.
